title: Unit 34 Consolidation: Globalisation & Geopolitics
goal: Consolidate proportional correlatives, formal causal frames, passive *se*, source attribution and the future perfect in geopolitical analysis.

items: I can express proportional interdependence and projected global shifts accurately.
I can distinguish prepositional, clausal and treaty-based causal connectors.
I can report multilateral actions with passive se or ser + participle and attribute positions neutrally.
I can project long-term realignments and infer recent past causes with the futuro perfecto.
